issues: The backup passphrase validation incorrectly allows passphrases of length 11: `validateBackupPassphrase` uses `if (p.length < 11)` but the requirement is a minimum of 12 characters. This off‑by‑one error means a passphrase with 11 characters passes validation, violating the spec. Update the check to `if (p.length < 12)` (or equivalent) and adjust any related logic/tests accordingly.
feedback: All current tests pass, but the implementation does not enforce the required minimum passphrase length of 12 characters. Fix the validation logic to correctly enforce the 12‑character rule.
